jobReports.pnlFoot: Revenue is the invoice before tax; without an invoice, the price on the job. Labor is on-site hours × the pay rate in Team. Materials are the parts on the job at cost. Expenses are the ones linked to the job's invoice in Finances. This is the profit of the jobs only. Rent, fuel, insurance and what was really paid in payroll are in Finances → Reports. Use This week or This month above, then Print / PDF to hand it to the owner. Only the owner and the manager see this tab.
